subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama setup fail after 300 seconds without an increase in aggregate completed bytes, even when the daemon continues emitting legitimate status-only phase updates?
rationale: The patch fixes a real infinite-hang path, but Ollama's upstream stream contract includes healthy phases without completed counters, so accepting completed-only progress is an intentional compatibility and setup policy choice.

options.title: Accept completed-only progress
options.body: Keep the current 300-second watchdog, accepting that unusually slow status-only verification or manifest phases may be canceled to guarantee setup termination.

options.title: Count phase transitions
options.body: Rearm the watchdog when aggregate bytes increase or the stream enters a distinct legitimate status phase, while repeated identical status drips remain bounded.

options.title: Preserve unlimited post-header pulls
options.body: Do not add the semantic watchdog and retain manual cancellation as the only recovery from non-idle dripping streams.

recommendation.title: Accept completed-only progress
recommendation.body: Keep the current 300-second watchdog, accepting that unusually slow status-only verification or manifest phases may be canceled to guarantee setup termination.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Ollama timeout work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the setup timeout contract.
